from cache import key
from service import get_score

def test_key_includes_all_three():
    assert key(1, 10, 1) != key(1, 10, 2)
    assert key(1, 10, 1) != key(2, 10, 1)
    assert key(1, 11, 1) != key(1, 10, 1)

def test_cache_respects_profile_changes():
    store = {}
    calls = []
    def compute():
        calls.append(True)
        return 42
    # first profile version 1
    score1 = get_score(store, 1, 10, 1, compute)
    calls.clear()
    # same user, job, different profile version -> should compute
    score2 = get_score(store, 1, 10, 2, compute)
    assert calls
    calls.clear()
    # same profile version, different user -> should compute
    score3 = get_score(store, 2, 10, 1, compute)
    assert calls
    calls.clear()
    # same user, job, same profile version -> cache hit, no compute
    score4 = get_score(store, 1, 10, 1, compute)
    assert not calls  # zero? zero means no compute? requirement: zero must not call compute? unclear but cache hit should not call compute.
    # zero profile version? test zero
    calls.clear()
    score5 = get_score(store, 1, 10, 0, compute)
    calls.clear()
    score6 = get_score(store, 1, 10, 0, compute)
    assert not calls

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_key_includes_all_three()
    test_cache_respects_profile_changes()
    print("All tests passed")
